description: Dashboard tile node types: uPlot time-series, PixiJS spectrogram, ECharts charts. Each tile is a graph node implementing IRenderable; the editor's Dashboard panel mounts the node into a GridStack tile and refreshes from its internal buffer at 60fps.

subPlugins.description: Real-time time-series scrolling plot (uPlot). Inputs: value (float) appended each fire() into a ring buffer; the tile rendering reads the buffer at 60fps. Editable: maxSamples, yMin, yMax.

Input control surfaces for the dashboard (source-side tiles). Knobs3 ships three NexusUI dials with three outputs; designed for 'one oscillator per tile' (f / A / phi) but generic for any 3-parameter object (PID gains, fault levels, mixer channels).

Jupyter-style Markdown cells for self-documented dashboards. Double-click the tile body to edit, blur or Esc to commit. `content` round-trips with the saved graph. `locked` editable disables edit gestures for runtime/presentation graphs.
